verdict.rationale: GitHub has its own mechanisms in this area. A community comment lists protected branches and code owners as paid private-repo features, and the docs describe GitHub Actions workflow automation and a PR flow where changes are 'reviewed for quality and security, and be merged.' None of this explicitly documents making custom checks required before merging. missing for 10: first-party docs on required status checks or rulesets that block merges, evidence that custom Actions/app checks can be made mandatory gates, org-wide compliance policy enforcement, independent hands-on corroboration.
